comment: Provenance ledger for agents/review-guide-templates/. One entry per concrete upstream repo (Gate-P F4, guides-revamp 2026-07-11; profile rewrite review-recall 2026-07-15); multiple entries may feed one file. INT-06 asserts set equality: templates dir *.md minus TRACEABILITY.md (migration/canary registry, not corpus) == union(feeds_guides). Old-corpus filenames inside 'rejected' reasons are historical audit text - TRACEABILITY.md maps them. 'rejected' entries are audit-only - do not re-add them as sources without new evidence.
